gallery.title: File:Panorama of Greater Kota Kinabalu.jpg
gallery.description:
KK has experienced a property boom with new highrises dotting the city above lush green treetops over the last few years. This view was dissimilar five years back.


In this photo, eagle eyed observers may notice Elemen Utara KK coming up, with the new city court complex nearby. The centre of the shot is dominated by Harrington Suites. Towards the right is the skyline of Inanam and Kolombong, with the Ashton Tower on the far right.
